excerpt.zh: 这颗小行星最近被小行星带里的一颗行星撞击了。其表面留下了一个巨大的撞击坑，同时轨道也有所偏离。
excerpt.en: This asteroid recently suffered an impact from another body within the asteroid belt, which resulted in a slightly changed orbit and a massive crater on the surface.

texts.zh: 通过近距离查看，我们发现了一颗几乎全部由贵金属组成的小行星最近与[From.GetName]发生撞击。该致密的金属球体被埋藏在了小行星的地表下，应该具备开采条件。
texts.en: Upon closer examination, we have discovered that a smaller asteroid consisting almost entirely of precious metals recently collided with [From.GetName]. This small but dense cache of metals was hidden just beneath the asteroid's surface, but now that it has been discovered it should be accessible to mining.

texts.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]期望在[From.GetName]内部发现稀有资源，结果偶然撞见了一样极其不寻常的东西。这个看起来像是普通小行星的物体事实上是一个长期休眠的中继站，里面有复杂的电子元件和先进的传感器，用以向某个古老的帝国发送信号。这些撞击也损毁了小行星的一部分内部构造，我们只能从中提取到一个恒星系。
texts.en: Hoping to discover rare resources inside [From.GetName], our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] stumbled upon something most unusual. What had appeared to be a simple asteroid was in fact a long-dormant relay station with complex electronics and advanced sensors set up to send signals back to an ancient empire. The impact also has damaged some of the asteroid's internal structure, and we can only extract one system from it.

# 小行星碰撞 / Asteroid Collision

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/00_anomaly_categories.txt:139; events/anomaly_events_1.txt:416 (anomaly.55); events/anomaly_events_4.txt:2429 (anomaly.6805)

## 如何开始 How it starts

小行星可能生成（1级，权重3，全局一次 max_once）。

Can spawn on an asteroid (level 1, weight 3, once per game via max_once).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

anomaly.55“小行星碰撞”（采矿矿藏 d_minerals_3；若星球有战略资源则权重为0）与 anomaly.6805“小行星敏感中继器”（选项a：asteroid_relay_stations 修正并记录标本 ancient_sensor；选项b：asteroid_encryption 修正）。

anomaly.55 "Asteroid Collision" (d_minerals_3 deposit; weight 0 if the planet has a strategic resource) and anomaly.6805 "Asteroid Sensor Relay" (a: asteroid_relay_stations modifier and specimen ancient_sensor; b: asteroid_encryption modifier).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

两个结果互斥，各50%。

The results are exclusive, 50% each.

无文明差异。

No empire differences.
